about: Look presets for the series config's style.look (the series form's Look): each a director of photography's brief, one sentence of what the lens, focus, light and stock (or the drawing) do (docs/AUTHORING.md, Writing the look line). Picking one fills the line, which stays the series' own to edit. The sample pictures are img/look/<id>.jpg, the same scene in each look, made by tools/make_preset_samples.py. `parts` is the preset in the look builder's rows (look_builder.json), so picking it sets them too.

presets.label: Prestige drama
presets.text: a naturalistic live-action prestige drama shot on 35mm anamorphic lenses: shallow depth of field with the background falling into soft bokeh, low-key light from the practical lamps in each room, deep soft shadows with lifted blacks, muted desaturated color and fine film grain

presets.label: Neon noir
presets.text: a live-action neo-noir thriller shot on 35mm anamorphic lenses: shallow depth of field, night streets lit by neon signs in magenta and cyan, wet surfaces full of reflections, deep black shadows, saturated color and fine film grain

presets.label: 1970s film
presets.text: a live-action 1970s feature shot on 35mm film with zoom lenses: available natural light, warm faded color with soft contrast, visible film grain and a slight halation around the highlights

presets.label: Documentary
presets.text: a live-action documentary shot handheld on a digital cinema camera with a wide-angle lens: deep focus, real available light, natural true-to-life color and a slight handheld drift

presets.label: Black and white
presets.text: a black-and-white live-action film noir shot on 35mm: hard low-key light from single sources, deep black shadows and bright edges, high contrast and fine silver grain

presets.label: Cool science fiction
presets.text: a live-action science-fiction film shot on large-format digital with spherical lenses: clean precise focus, cool blue-teal light from practical panels and screens, crisp highlights and controlled, sterile color

presets.label: Sunlit pastoral
presets.text: a live-action period drama shot on 35mm with soft vintage lenses: natural window light and golden late-afternoon sun, warm painterly color, gentle contrast and soft film grain

presets.label: 3D animated feature
presets.text: a 3D animated feature film: soft rounded character design with expressive faces, subsurface-scattered skin, warm global illumination with soft bounce light, gentle depth of field and rich saturated color

presets.label: 2D cartoon
presets.text: a 2D hand-drawn cartoon animation with flat 2D illustration, clean black line art, flat solid colors, and cel-shaded artwork

presets.label: Anime
presets.text: a Japanese anime film in hand-drawn 2D: clean expressive line art, cel-shaded characters over richly painted backgrounds, luminous skies and soft atmospheric light

presets.label: Stop-motion
presets.text: a stop-motion animated film with handmade clay and felt puppets on miniature sets: visible fingerprints and fabric texture, small practical lamps, shallow macro depth of field

presets.label: Watercolor storybook
presets.text: a watercolor storybook illustration come to life: soft wet-edged washes of color on textured paper, loose ink outlines, gentle diffuse light and a limited warm palette

presets.label: Graphic novel
presets.text: a graphic novel come to life: bold black ink lines and heavy spot blacks, flat limited color with halftone shading, hard dramatic light and strong silhouettes
